title: Onboarding
purpose: Get someone new to value with a stamped setup checklist, empty states before tours, and what's new.
useWhen: A new workspace or account needs a few setup tasks, or an existing interface changed.
avoidWhen: Teaching the whole product up front with a modal carousel or a long tour.
alternatives: Use EmptyState alone for a single empty region, and Tour only for a change to an interface people already use.
requiredInputs: setup tasks with where each is done
application events when each task happens
empty regions with their one next step
the list of changes and which are unseen
transitions: guide-open → task-done when the application reports the task happened
guide-open → guide-skipped, or guide-complete → guide-hidden; Help reopens it
empty → filled by its one action, stamping the task
tour-offered → touring only when asked → done or skipped
applicability: First-run setup, empty states, tours of changes and release notes.
exceptions: Require only the parts the product offers; products without setup tasks still prefer empty states to tours.
